(8) The camera focuses on a woven brown rug on the floor. A hand holding a TV remote points toward a seating area with two gray floor cushions and a yellow pillow. (9) A 'SAMPO' branded television is turned on, showing a variety talk show. (10) A hand opens a small silver refrigerator. (11) A basket contains a pink hairdryer and a pair of orange earplugs in clear plastic packaging. (12) The man slides open a large window, revealing a view of a city with various gray buildings and a sign for the Liuhe Night Market. (13) A final pan of the sunlit room shows the overall layout, including a macramé wall decoration and plants on wooden shelves.
